notes.title: New update v1.01
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've updated the game with a small life improvement fixes.
You can check the humble patch notes below:

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improvements: You can now use the mouse as a controller in the Multiplayer Settings menu
[*] Balancing: Unlocking a character price lowered
[*] Balancing: Removed rolling for rewards with diamonds, because it was not really worth it. Additionally, players could mistakenly spend all diamonds on rerolls.
[/list]

If you happen to find any more tiny issues within the game, feel free to let us know under this announcement. Thank you!

Enjoy your time in Jumping Joe!
